question: A plane wavefront passes from glass to air. How does the angle of refraction compare with the angle of incidence? Give reason using wave speed.

options.A: The angle of refraction is smaller than the angle of incidence because light slows down on entering air.
options.B: The refracted ray is undeviated because glass and air have the same speed of light.
options.C: Light travels faster in air than in glass, so $v_2>v_1$. From $\dfrac{\sin i}{\sin r}=\dfrac{v_1}{v_2}<1$, $\sin r>\sin i$, hence $r>i$. The ray bends away from the normal.
options.D: The angle of refraction is always $90^\circ$ when light goes from glass to air.
